name: Exploration
description: Adult exploration, observation and fieldwork for one person, A. Entries give supports and occupied hands; choose activities that suit the requested terrain and equipment.

entries: A standing with feet apart, holding binoculars to their eyes with both hands.
A leaning over a railing, holding a camera with both hands and keeping their hips behind the rail.
A lying prone on a broad ledge, looking over its edge with elbows supporting their upper body.
A seated on a boulder, comparing a compass in one hand with a map resting across their knees.
A standing at a trail junction, pointing along one route while holding a folded map in the other hand.
A stepping across shallow water, one boot on a dry stone and the other lifted toward the next.
A standing beneath a low branch, holding it above their head with one hand while stepping through.
A testing the next patch of ground with a walking pole while keeping their weight on the rear foot.
A standing beside a packed bag, tightening one shoulder strap while the other hand steadies the bag.
A kneeling beside a rock outcrop, holding a sample bag open with one hand and lowering a stone into it with the other.
A crouching beside a footprint, pointing toward its edge without touching it.
A standing beside a tripod, adjusting its instrument with both feet on level ground.
A resting one hand on a rock face while leaning forward to examine a narrow crack.
A kneeling to press a marker into soft soil with one hand, the other braced on their thigh.
A seated beside an open field kit, labeling a small container on the ground.
A kneeling beside a stream, dipping a sample vial into the water with one hand.
A standing beside a measuring stake, aligning a handheld reader with its marked face.
A seated with a sketchbook on their knees, drawing a landmark visible ahead.
A crouching beneath a low opening with one hand touching the ground for balance.
A kneeling on firm ground, unrolling a groundsheet away from their knees.
